title: ECG foundation models for cardiovascular screening in a cohort of young competitive athletes
zh_title: ECG 基础模型用于年轻运动员心血管筛查
summary: 在 8.7 万条样本上微调三个 ECG 基础模型，外部运动员队列性能明显下降，ECGFounder 表现最佳。
key_points: 微调数据为 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 共 87662 条
临床数据 AUROC 0.97，运动员数据降至 0.84
运动员测试集仅 43 例，样本量小
reason: 跨人群外部验证但仅 43 例、回顾性，属值得一看档
abstract: AI-powered cardiac screening could evolve sports medicine by boosting accuracy, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, with automated ECG interpretation based on foundation models becoming key for large-scale athlete screening. Before deployment, it is crucial to verify whether these clinically developed models are applicable to this population. We evaluated whether ECG foundation models trained on general clinical populations can diagnose athlete-specific ECG findings. We fine-tuned three models (ECG-FM, HuBERT-ECG, ECGFounder) on PhysioNet/CinC 2021, 87,662 samples, and tested them on 43 expert-annotated ECGs from highly trained/national-level athletes. Performance was strong on PhysioNet/CinC 2021 (AUROC 0.97, AUPRC 0.57, Sensitivity 0.89) but dropped on athletes’ data, confirming domain shift. ECGFounder performed best (AUROC 0.84, AUPRC 0.72, Sensitivity 0.57) and detected the most frequent findings, Sinus Bradycardia (AUROC 0.87) and Sinus Arrhythmia (AUROC 0.95), well. Per-label estimates for rare classes must be interpreted cautiously, given the small cohort. This work contributes to developing athlete-focused AI frameworks for reliable ECG-based screening.
zh_abstract: AI 驱动的心脏筛查可通过提高准确性、效率和成本效益来推动运动医学发展，其中基于基础模型的自动心电图解读正成为大规模运动员筛查的关键。在部署前，至关重要的是验证这些在临床人群中开发的模型是否适用于该人群。我们评估了在一般临床人群中训练的心电图基础模型能否诊断运动员特异性心电图表现。我们在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 的 87,662 个样本上微调了三个模型（ECG-FM、HuBERT-ECG、ECGFounder），并在来自高度训练/国家级运动员的 43 份经专家标注的心电图上进行测试。模型在 PhysioNet/CinC 2021 上表现强劲（AUROC 0.97、AUPRC 0.57、Sensitivity 0.89），但在运动员数据上下降，证实了域偏移。ECGFounder 表现最佳（AUROC 0.84、AUPRC 0.72、Sensitivity 0.57），并良好检测了最常见表现，即窦性心动过缓（AUROC 0.87）和窦性心律不齐（AUROC 0.95）。鉴于队列较小，对稀有类别的逐标签估计必须谨慎解读。这项工作有助于开发以运动员为中心的 AI 框架，以实现可靠的心电图筛查。

title: Potential and pitfalls of artificial intelligence to address disparities in epilepsy.
zh_title: AI缓解癫痫诊疗不平等的潜力与陷阱
summary: 综述探讨AI通过脑电、手机数据与电子病历改善资源匮乏地区癫痫诊疗，并警示透明度与公平风险。
key_points: AI分析低成本开源脑电、手机与电子病历数据辅助癫痫诊断监测
关注临床专业能力保留、算法透明度与医疗公平
面向中低收入国家资源有限场景，需权衡技术红利与风险
reason: 同行评审综述，视角与公平议题有价值，但综述上限为6分
abstract: [Nature reviews. Neurology] The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and health care offers unprecedented opportunities to address global disparities in access to specialized epilepsy diagnosis and treatment, particularly in resource-limited settings. Advances in AI models, combined with increasing internet connectivity and smartphone usage in low-income and middle-income countries, offer promising solutions for epilepsy diagnosis and monitoring through AI-based analysis of electroencephalography recordings captured with affordable open-source systems, smartphone data and electronic health records. However, this technological revolution raises important questions about the preservation and expansion of clinical expertise, AI algorithm transparency and health-care equity. In this Review, we examine how AI can help to address disparities and improve global epilepsy care while maintaining high clinical standards and addressing systemic challenges.
zh_abstract: 《Nature Reviews Neurology》人工智能（AI）与医疗保健的融合为解决全球在获得专科癫痫诊断和治疗方面的差异提供了前所未有的机会，尤其是在资源有限的环境中。AI模型的进步，加之低收入和中等收入国家互联网连接和智能手机使用的增加，通过基于AI分析用负担得起的开源系统采集的脑电图记录、智能手机数据和电子健康记录，为癫痫诊断和监测提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，这场技术革命提出了关于临床专业知识的保留与扩展、AI算法透明度和医疗保健公平性的重要问题。在本综述中，我们考察AI如何帮助解决差异并改善全球癫痫照护，同时保持高临床标准并应对系统性挑战。

title: Generative AI adoption is more widespread than predictive AI at US hospitals.
zh_title: 美国医院生成式 AI 采用率高于预测式 AI
summary: 基于 2203 家美国医院 2025 年调查，81% 使用 AI，77% 使用生成式 AI，较 2024 年翻倍以上。
key_points: 样本为 2203 家非联邦急症医院
生成式 AI 使用率 77%，超 2024 年两倍
最常见用途为环境文档记录，占 73%
reason: 全国性大样本采用率调查，但为横断面描述，属值得一看档
abstract: [Health affairs scholar] Artificial intelligence (AI) adoption among U.S. hospitals has accelerated rapidly, yet national estimates of predictive and generative AI implementation across clinical and administrative settings remain limited. Using data from 2203 nonfederal acute care hospitals in the 2025 American Hospital Association Information Technology Survey, we described AI adoption, model source (electronic health record [EHR] developer, third-party developer, or self-developed), and specific clinical and administrative use cases. We assessed associations between hospital and area characteristics and AI adoption, model source, and number of AI use cases using weighted multivariable regression. In 2025, 81% of hospitals reported using AI, with 77% of hospitals using generative AI-more than double the rate reported in 2024. The most common applications were ambient documentation (73%) and predicting health trajectories or risks (70%). System affiliation and use of the market-leading EHR were the strongest predictors of AI adoption. Hospitals using EHR-developed AI reported 2.48 additional AI use cases (95% CI, 1.93-3.03). Generative AI adoption surpassed predictive AI for the first time, driven by ambient documentation. While use of EHR-developed AI was associated with greater use, there was a greater influence of third-party vendors for generative AI compared to predictive AI. Continued monitoring will be essential to assess AI's impact across healthcare.
zh_abstract: [Health affairs scholar] 美国医院对人工智能（AI）的采用已迅速加快，但关于预测性 AI 和生成式 AI 在临床与行政环境中实施的全国估计仍然有限。我们使用 2025 年美国医院协会信息技术调查（American Hospital Association Information Technology Survey）中 2203 家非联邦急性护理医院的数据，描述了 AI 采用情况、模型来源（电子健康记录 [EHR] 开发商、第三方开发商或自行开发）以及具体临床和行政用例。我们使用加权多变量回归评估了医院和地区特征与 AI 采用、模型来源及 AI 用例数量之间的关联。2025 年，81% 的医院报告使用 AI，其中 77% 的医院使用生成式 AI——是 2024 年报告率的两倍多。最常见应用是环境记录（ambient documentation，73%）和预测健康轨迹或风险（70%）。系统隶属关系和市场领先 EHR 的使用是 AI 采用的最强预测因素。使用 EHR 开发商开发的 AI 的医院报告了额外 2.48 个 AI 用例（95% CI，1.93-3.03）。生成式 AI 的采用首次超过预测性 AI，这由环境记录推动。虽然使用 EHR 开发商开发的 AI 与更多使用相关，但与预测性 AI 相比，第三方供应商对生成式 AI 的影响更大。持续监测对于评估 AI 在整个医疗保健中的影响至关重要。

title: The Transformative Role of Artificial Intelligence in Wearable Health Monitoring: Applications in Diagnosis, Therapy, and Rehabilitation.
source: PubMed · Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)
zh_title: AI在可穿戴健康监测中的转化作用
summary: 综述章节探讨AI增强可穿戴技术在诊断、治疗与康复动态健康监测中的应用与未来方向。
key_points: 涵盖心血管病实时检测与连续血糖监测
涉及智能给药贴片、远程干预与AR手术导航
未来依赖多功能硬件、联邦学习与可解释AI
reason: 综述章节泛述应用，无新数据，增量档
abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] This chapter explores the transformative impact of artificial intelligence (AI)-augmented wearable technology in dynamic health monitoring across diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation. Innovations include real-time cardiovascular disease detection, AI-driven continuous glucose monitoring for diabetes, and neurological disorder tracking using flexible electroencephalograph (EEG) sensors. Therapeutic advances feature smart drug-delivery patches responsive to biomarkers, remote intervention systems, and surgical tools like augmented reality (AR) navigation. Rehabilitation breakthroughs encompass wearables for motor recovery, cardiopulmonary optimization, and neurorehabilitation using brain-computer interfaces. Future progress hinges on multifunctional hardware, federated learning for privacy, explainable AI, and standardized regulations.
zh_abstract: [Methods in Molecular Biology (Clifton, N.J.)] 本章探讨人工智能（AI）增强的可穿戴技术在诊断、治疗和康复动态健康监测中的变革性影响。创新包括实时心血管疾病检测、AI 驱动的糖尿病连续血糖监测，以及使用柔性脑电图（EEG）传感器进行神经系统疾病追踪。治疗进展包括响应生物标志物的智能药物递送贴片、远程干预系统，以及增强现实（AR）导航等手术工具。康复突破包括用于运动恢复、心肺优化以及使用脑机接口进行神经康复的可穿戴设备。未来进展取决于多功能硬件、保护隐私的联邦学习、可解释 AI 和标准化法规。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Precision Nutrition: From Multi-Omics Integration to Personalized Dietary Interventions.
zh_title: AI在精准营养中的应用：从多组学到个体化干预
summary: 叙述性综述考察机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、NLP与多组学在精准营养中的应用。
key_points: AI可分析饮食、临床、生理与分子数据
区分预测研究、数字营养与商业平台
数字精准营养可改善部分饮食行为
reason: 叙述性综述，无新数据，证据有限，增量档
abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated as a tool for precision nutrition because it can analyse heterogeneous dietary, clinical, physiological, behavioural, and molecular data. This narrative review critically examines how machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, explainable AI, continuous glucose monitoring, wearable technologies, and multi-omics approaches may support individualized nutritional assessment and decision-making. Particular attention is given to the distinction between predictive research, digital personalized nutrition, AI-enabled clinical interventions, and commercial nutrition platforms. Current evidence shows that personalized digital nutrition can improve selected dietary behaviours, while observational AI and multi-omics studies can predict substantial inter-individual variation in metabolic responses. Importantly, evidence that an AI-enabled intervention improves clinical outcomes is still limited and is concentrated in selected settings, including a multicentre randomized trial of an AI-based dietary management platform in adults with type 2 diabetes. Emerging technologies such as large language models, digital twins, federated learning, and adaptive algorithms remain promising but require prospective clinical validation. Major barriers include data quality, algorithmic bias, privacy, interoperability, model transparency, regulatory uncertainty, and limited external validation. Future research should prioritize pragmatic multicentre randomized trials, transparent reporting of model performance, independent validation, health-economic evaluation, and clinically meaningful outcomes. AI should therefore be considered an adjunct to evidence-based nutritional care rather than a replacement for professional clinical judgement. The review differs from technology-centred and methodology-focused reviews by explicitly linking AI modalities and multi-omics data with evidence maturity, clinical trial findings, implementation barriers, and the level of inference justified for each technology.
zh_abstract: 《Clinical Nutrition ESPEN》人工智能（AI）正越来越多地被研究作为精准营养的工具，因为它能够分析异质性的膳食、临床、生理、行为和分子数据。本叙述性综述批判性地考察机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、自然语言处理、可解释AI、连续血糖监测、可穿戴技术和多组学方法如何可能支持个体化营养评估与决策。特别关注预测性研究、数字个性化营养、AI赋能的临床干预与商业营养平台之间的区别。当前证据显示，个性化数字营养可以改善选定的膳食行为，而观察性AI和多组学研究可以预测代谢反应中显著的个体间差异。重要的是，AI赋能干预改善临床结局的证据仍然有限，且集中于选定环境，包括一项在2型糖尿病成人中开展的基于AI的膳食管理平台的多中心随机试验。大语言模型、数字孪生、联邦学习和自适应算法等新兴技术仍有前景，但需要前瞻性临床验证。主要障碍包括数据质量、算法偏倚、隐私、互操作性、模型透明度、监管不确定性以及有限的外部验证。未来研究应优先开展实用性多中心随机试验、模型性能的透明报告、独立验证、卫生经济学评价以及具有临床意义的结局。因此，AI应被视为循证营养照护的辅助手段，而不是专业临床判断的替代品。本综述不同于以技术为中心和以方法学为重点的综述，因为它明确将AI模式和多组学数据与证据成熟度、临床试验发现、实施障碍以及每种技术所能支持的推断水平联系起来。

title: AI-driven Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics in triple-negative breast cancer: mapping the immune landscape for precision immunotherapy.
zh_title: AI驱动免疫-放射-多组学用于三阴性乳腺癌
summary: 文章讨论AI影像组学联合多组学刻画三阴性乳腺癌免疫微环境，以支持精准免疫治疗。
key_points: TNBC肿瘤免疫微环境高度异质，影响免疫治疗反应
PD-L1与TILs评估受取样偏差和空间异质性限制
AI影像组学可将常规影像转为无创高通量生物标志物
reason: 同行评审综述，梳理AI影像组学与多组学在TNBC的应用，无原始数据。
abstract: [Frontiers in immunology] In triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is highly heterogeneous and constitutes a key determinant of response to immunotherapy. Nevertheless, current clinical assessment of biomarkers, notably programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), relies primarily on static and localized tissue sampling, constrained by spatial heterogeneity, sampling bias, and lack of longitudinal assessment, which limits its capacity to fully represent the evolving TIME and support adaptive treatment decision-making. Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven radiomics has emerged as a non-invasive framework enabling the conversion of routine imaging into high-throughput biomarkers, capturing TIME imaging phenotypes. When integrated with genomic data, this strategy extends into radiogenomics, allowing the association of radiomics features with underlying molecular features to better characterize the TNBC landscape. However, given the inter/intra-diversity of TNBC-TIME, integrating complementary multi-omics layers becomes necessary to fully reflect TIME landscape and represent the interplay between TIME components. Several findings from studies on solid tumors, including TNBC, suggest that AI-derived radiomics signatures are associated with immune and molecular patterns and may predict PD-L1 expression, TILs, TIME phenotypes and response to immune checkpoint blockade. Beyond static and isolated biomarker development, 'Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics' could enable dynamic non-invasive whole-tumor immune profiling, enhanced patient stratification, and support the future development of longitudinal and adaptive therapeutic strategies. Meanwhile, its clinical translation is currently limited by the lack of large and prospective datasets, standardization, validation and interpretability. Through this mini-review, we aim to critically discuss current evidence, limitations and next frontiers of 'Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics' in TNBC, emphasizing its potential to advance dynamic and personalized immunotherapy strategies in TNBC.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in Immunology] 在三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）中，肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）高度异质，是免疫治疗反应的关键决定因素。然而，目前生物标志物的临床评估，尤其是程序性死亡配体 1（PD-L1）表达和肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TILs），主要依赖于静态和局部组织取样，受空间异质性、取样偏倚及缺乏纵向评估的限制，这限制了其充分代表不断演变的 TIME 并支持适应性治疗决策的能力。人工智能（AI）驱动的放射组学已成为一种非侵入性框架，能够将常规影像转化为高通量生物标志物，捕捉 TIME 影像表型。当与基因组数据整合时，该策略延伸至放射基因组学，使放射组学特征与潜在分子特征相关联，从而更好地刻画 TNBC 图景。然而，鉴于 TNBC-TIME 的间/内多样性，整合互补的多组学层面变得必要，以充分反映 TIME 图景并表征 TIME 各组分之间的相互作用。包括 TNBC 在内的实体瘤研究的一些发现提示，AI 衍生的放射组学特征与免疫和分子模式相关，并可能预测 PD-L1 表达、TILs、TIME 表型及对免疫检查点阻断的反应。超越静态和孤立的生物标志物开发，“Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics”可实现动态、非侵入性的全肿瘤免疫分析，增强患者分层，并支持纵向和适应性治疗策略的未来发展。同时，其临床转化目前受限于缺乏大型前瞻性数据集、标准化、验证和可解释性。通过本小型综述，我们旨在批判性讨论“Immuno-Radio-Multi-Omics”在 TNBC 中的当前证据、局限性和下一前沿，强调其推进 TNBC 动态和个性化免疫治疗策略的潜力。

title: Calibrating trust in generative artificial intelligence for clinical communication through Chinese medical humanism.
zh_title: 以中国医学人文校准生成式AI临床沟通信任
summary: 小型综述讨论以中国医学人文理念校准生成式AI在临床沟通中的信任边界。
key_points: 生成式AI已进入患者消息、健康教育与对话式决策支持
需区分感知共情与关系责任、技术表现与患者获益
仁爱、诚、整体关注与情境判断可作信任校准资源
reason: 规范性的小型综述，有信息量但无实证数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Generative artificial intelligence is entering clinical communication through patient messaging, health education, and conversational decision support. Its capacity to produce reassuring language can coexist with inaccurate advice, unclear responsibility, and culturally inappropriate explanations. This mini-review examines how Chinese medical humanism can inform the calibration of trust in these encounters. Targeted literature identification integrates studies of trust and perceived empathy, research on traditional Chinese medicine communication, and medical education evidence with normative scholarship. The evidence distinguishes perceived empathy from relational accountability and technical performance from demonstrated patient benefit. Chinese medical ideals of benevolence, sincerity, holistic attention, and contextual judgment offer resources for interpreting professional responsibilities, but their incorporation into artificial intelligence has not been shown to restore trust or improve health outcomes. We synthesize these insights into a proposed dual-verification approach: an epistemic track checks evidence, uncertainty, and safety, while a relational track checks patient understanding, cultural meaning, preferences, and access to human care. Their convergence supports accountable communication and allows unresolved concerns to trigger human review. Educational applications connect critical appraisal of generated responses with reflection on classical medical ethics. Evaluation should prioritize appropriate reliance, error recognition, patient agency, and equitable access rather than maximizing trust scores. This approach reframes humanistic integration as a set of responsibilities for clinicians and institutions, with its effectiveness remaining an empirical question.
zh_abstract: 《Frontiers in Public Health》生成式人工智能正通过患者消息传递、健康教育和对话式决策支持进入临床沟通。其生成令人安心语言的能力可能与不准确建议、责任不清和文化上不恰当的解釋并存。本小型综述考察中国医学人文主义如何为这些互动中的信任校准提供依据。有针对性的文献识别将信任与感知共情的研究、中医沟通研究以及医学教育证据与规范性学术研究相结合。证据区分了感知共情与关系性问责，以及技术性能与已证实的患者获益。中国医学中仁爱、真诚、整体关注和情境判断的理想为解释专业责任提供了资源，但将其纳入人工智能尚未被证明能够恢复信任或改善健康结局。我们将这些见解综合为一种提出的双重验证方法：认知轨道检查证据、不确定性和安全性，而关系轨道检查患者理解、文化意义、偏好和获得人类照护的机会。二者的汇聚支持可问责的沟通，并允许未解决的担忧触发人工审查。教育应用将生成回答的批判性评价与对经典医学伦理的反思联系起来。评价应优先考虑适当依赖、错误识别、患者能动性和公平可及，而不是最大化信任评分。这种方法将人文整合重新界定为临床医生和机构的一套责任，其有效性仍是一个实证问题。

title: Individual Probability of Successful Extubation Using a Neural Network: A Proof-of-Concept Analysis.
zh_title: 神经网络预测个体拔管成功概率
summary: 概念验证研究用 14 项以呼吸为主的参数构建单隐层神经网络，输出个体拔管成功概率。
key_points: 14 项呼吸参数输入，单隐层网络输出单一概率
训练集仅 17 例，其中 13 例拔管成功
结果显示成功与失败组分离度较好
reason: 单中心极小样本（17 例）概念验证，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Rhode Island medical journal (2013)] Studies have shown that artificial intelligence can aid in extubating patients from ventilators, but none have used predominantly respiratory parameters to yield a simple probability of successful extubation that can immediately aid clinicians in their decision to extubate or not extubate patients. We sought to determine whether it is possible to create a neural network as a proof-of-concept analysis using predominantly respiratory parameters to derive a single probability of successful extubation for an individual patient. Fourteen predominantly respiratory parameters were the input for a neural network with one hidden layer to yield a single output, a simple probability of extubation. The system trained on 17 patients, 13 of whom successfully extubated, four of whom failed. The results showed excellent separation between the extubation successes and failures. When applied to the test group of four patients, there also was excellent separation between the three successful extubations (prediction range: 98.8% to 100% probability) and the one failure (2.9% probability). This proof-of-concept analysis showed that it is possible to use predominantly respiratory parameters to present a single number, a probability of extubation, as the output from a neural network. This analysis needs to be performed on a larger sample before it can be applied confidently, but the framework now is available for further development to assist intensivists who work with ventilated patients.
zh_abstract: 《Rhode Island Medical Journal (2013)》研究显示，人工智能可以帮助患者脱离呼吸机拔管，但尚无研究使用以呼吸参数为主的数据来给出一个简单的成功拔管概率，从而能够立即帮助临床医生决定是否对患者拔管。我们试图确定是否可能创建一个神经网络，作为概念验证分析，使用以呼吸参数为主的数据，为单个患者推导出一个成功拔管的单一概率。14个以呼吸参数为主的参数作为一个具有一个隐藏层的神经网络的输入，以产生单一输出，即一个简单的拔管概率。该系统在17名患者上训练，其中13名成功拔管，4名失败。结果显示拔管成功与失败之间有极好的区分度。当应用于4名患者的测试组时，3例成功拔管（预测范围：概率98.8%至100%）与1例失败（概率2.9%）之间也有极好的区分度。这项概念验证分析表明，有可能使用以呼吸参数为主的数据，将单一数字——拔管概率——作为神经网络的输出呈现。该分析需要在更大样本上进行，才能有把握地应用，但该框架现在可用于进一步开发，以帮助处理机械通气患者的重症监护医生。

title: Deep learning reconstruction for low-dose thoracic CT of calcification inserts: A phantom study of CNR, noise magnitude, and noise texture.
source: PubMed · Journal of applied clinical medical physics
zh_title: 深度学习重建用于低剂量胸部 CT 钙化体模研究
summary: 在体模上比较 FBP、50% ASiR 与中等强度 DLIR 的 CNR、噪声幅度与噪声纹理表现。
key_points: QRM 胸部体模含心脏钙化插件，80–140 kVp 多条件扫描
比较 FBP、ASiR 与 DLIR 三种重建方式
以 CNR、背景噪声与噪声功率谱为评价指标
reason: 纯体模、无临床数据与对照结局的技术比较，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] To compare filtered back projection (FBP), 50% Adaptive Statistical Iterative Reconstruction-Veo (ASiR), and medium-strength deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR) for hydroxyapatite calcification inserts under different dose, tube-voltage, and phantom-size conditions using contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), background noise magnitude, and noise power spectrum (NPS) analysis. A QRM-Thorax containing a QRM-CCI D100 cardiac calcification insert was scanned on a GE Revolution Apex CT system using institution-defined routine and low-dose protocols at 80, 100, 120, and 140 kVp, with and without an Extension Ring L. Images were reconstructed at 2.5-mm thickness using FBP, ASiR, and DLIR. CNR was evaluated for 3- and 5-mm inserts at 200, 400, and 800 mg HA/cm3. Background noise was assessed from a calcification-excluded mask. For NPS analysis, 10 calcification-free images were analyzed for each acquisition condition. Total two-dimensional NPS power, power-weighted normalized radial NPS, and power-weighted mean spatial frequency were calculated. DLIR reduced background noise magnitude and increased CNR relative to FBP across the evaluated conditions, whereas differences relative to ASiR varied with insert size, density, tube voltage, and phantom size. Across all 16 protocol, phantom-size, and tube-voltage combinations, ASiR and DLIR reduced total 2D NPS power by 58.1% and 75.8%, respectively, relative to FBP; DLIR reduced total power by 41.9% relative to ASiR. ASiR produced a more consistent shift toward lower power-weighted mean spatial frequencies, averaging 12.4% below FBP, whereas the shift with DLIR was smaller and more condition dependent, averaging 3.2% below FBP. In this controlled phantom study, DLIR reduced total noise power and improved CNR relative to FBP, but its incremental difference from ASiR was task and protocol dependent. CNR and noise magnitude should be interpreted together with NPS because nonlinear reconstruction methods can alter both noise magnitude and spatial-frequency distribution.
zh_abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] 旨在使用对比噪声比（CNR）、背景噪声幅度和噪声功率谱（NPS）分析，比较滤波反投影（FBP）、50% 自适应统计迭代重建-Veo（ASiR）和中等强度深度学习图像重建（DLIR）在不同剂量、管电压和体模尺寸条件下对羟基磷灰石钙化插入物的表现。使用机构定义的常规和低剂量方案，在 80、100、120 和 140 kVp 下，在有和无 Extension Ring L 的情况下，于 GE Revolution Apex CT 系统上扫描了包含 QRM-CCI D100 心脏钙化插入物的 QRM-Thorax 体模。图像以 2.5 mm 层厚使用 FBP、ASiR 和 DLIR 重建。对 200、400 和 800 mg HA/cm3 的 3 mm 和 5 mm 插入物评估 CNR。从排除钙化的掩膜评估背景噪声。对每种采集条件分析 10 幅无钙化图像以进行 NPS 分析。计算总二维 NPS 功率、功率加权归一化径向 NPS 和功率加权平均空间频率。在所有评估条件下，DLIR 相对 FBP 降低背景噪声幅度并提高 CNR，而相对 ASiR 的差异随插入物尺寸、密度、管电压和体模尺寸而变化。在所有 16 种方案、体模尺寸和管电压组合中，ASiR 和 DLIR 相对 FBP 分别将总二维 NPS 功率降低 58.1% 和 75.8%；DLIR 相对 ASiR 将总功率降低 41.9%。ASiR 产生更一致的向较低功率加权平均空间频率的偏移，平均比 FBP 低 12.4%，而 DLIR 的偏移较小且更依赖条件，平均比 FBP 低 3.2%。在这项受控体模研究中，DLIR 相对 FBP 降低了总噪声功率并改善了 CNR，但其相对于 ASiR 的增量差异取决于任务和方案。CNR 和噪声幅度应与 NPS 一起解读，因为非线性重建方法可同时改变噪声幅度和空间频率分布。

title: Evaluating readability of AI-generated pediatric dental education materials.
zh_title: AI 生成儿童口腔健康教育材料可读性评估
summary: 向六款 AI 聊天机器人各提交 10 个儿童口腔健康问题，用六项可读性指标评估 60 篇文本。
key_points: 涉及 GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 3 Flash、DeepSeek-V3 等六款模型
共生成 60 篇文本，采用区组重复测量设计
以 FRE、FKGL 等六项指标对照 AMA 推荐水平
reason: 设计规范但仅评估可读性指标、无临床结局，属增量偏上档
abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have become a popular source of oral health information. However, the patient education materials (PEMs) generated by these models often pose readability challenges. This study aimed to: (1) compare the readability of PEMs generated by six AI chatbots in response to ten frequently asked questions on pediatric oral health; and (2) determine whether the readability of these texts meets the level recommended by the American Medical Association (AMA). Ten sample questions on pediatric oral health were compiled. Each question was submitted once to each of six AI chatbots (GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Flash, Claude Haiku 4.5, DeepSeek-V3, Kimi K2.5, and Qwen3-Max), generating a corpus of 60 texts in a blocked (repeated-measures) design. Six readability indices - Flesch Reading Ease (FRE), Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL), Gunning Fog Index (GFI), Coleman-Liau Index (CLI), Simple Measure of Gobbledygook (SMOG), and Automated Readability Index (ARI) - were calculated for every text. Each index was analysed separately using the Friedman test, with the ten questions as blocks and the six models as conditions, followed by Dunn's multiple comparison test. Kendall's coefficient of concordance (W) was calculated to quantify the consistency of model ranking across questions. DeepSeek-V3 showed the highest readability (easiest texts) and Gemini 3 Flash the second highest, whereas Claude Haiku 4.5 showed the lowest readability across all six indices; GPT-5 Mini, Qwen3-Max, and Kimi K2.5 occupied intermediate positions. All six Friedman tests were statistically significant (χ 2(5) = 31.77-35.94, all p < 0.0001), and Kendall's W ranged from 0.635 to 0.719, indicating that the relative ranking of the six models was broadly consistent across the ten questions. Against the AMA-recommended sixth-grade reading level, all models exceeded the recommended difficulty on every index; even against a more lenient seventh-grade threshold, only the ARI median of DeepSeek-V3 (6.5) fell below 7. The PEMs generated by the six LLMs were written at a reading level above the AMA recommendation, and reading difficulty differed systematically among models. Readability should be explicitly controlled through prompt design, model optimisation, and professional review before such materials are used in pediatric oral health education.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in digital health] 通用大型语言模型（LLMs）已成为口腔健康信息的热门来源。然而，这些模型生成的患者教育材料（PEMs）常常在可读性方面带来挑战。本研究旨在：（1）比较六个 AI 聊天机器人针对十个儿童口腔健康常见问题生成的 PEM 的可读性；（2）确定这些文本的可读性是否达到美国医学会（AMA）推荐的水平。编制了 10 个儿童口腔健康示例问题。将每个问题各提交一次给六个 AI 聊天机器人（GPT-5 Mini、Gemini 3 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5、DeepSeek-V3、Kimi K2.5 和 Qwen3-Max），采用区组（重复测量）设计生成包含 60 篇文本的语料库。对每篇文本计算六种可读性指数——Flesch Reading Ease（FRE）、Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level（FKGL）、Gunning Fog Index（GFI）、Coleman-Liau Index（CLI）、Simple Measure of Gobbledygook（SMOG）和 Automated Readability Index（ARI）。每个指数分别使用 Friedman 检验分析，以十个问题为区组、六个模型为条件，随后进行 Dunn 多重比较检验。计算 Kendall 一致性系数（W）以量化各问题间模型排名的一致性。DeepSeek-V3 显示最高可读性（文本最容易），Gemini 3 Flash 第二高，而 Claude Haiku 4.5 在全部六种指数上显示最低可读性；GPT-5 Mini、Qwen3-Max 和 Kimi K2.5 处于中间位置。六项 Friedman 检验均具有统计学显著性（χ 2(5) = 31.77-35.94，所有 p < 0.0001），Kendall 的 W 范围为 0.635 至 0.719，表明六个模型的相对排名在十个问题间总体一致。相对于 AMA 推荐的六年级阅读水平，所有模型在每个指数上均超过推荐难度；即使采用更宽松的七年级阈值，也只有 DeepSeek-V3 的 ARI 中位数（6.5）低于 7。六个 LLM 生成的 PEM 的阅读水平高于 AMA 推荐，且不同模型间阅读难度存在系统性差异。在此类材料用于儿童口腔健康教育之前，应通过提示设计、模型优化和专业审查明确控制可读性。

title: CryoID2: deep learning-enhanced identification of protein and RNA from cryoEM maps.
source: PubMed · bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
zh_title: CryoID2：深度学习从冷冻电镜图识别蛋白与 RNA
summary: 预印本提出 CryoID2，用三个 3D U-Net 预测特征并结合序列检索与结构拟合鉴定冷冻电镜图组分。
key_points: 三个 3D U-Net 输出结构类别、关键原子与简化残基类型
蛋白用 BLASTp、RNA 用 maximin 策略排序候选序列
检索 PDB 或 AlphaFold 模型刚性拟合后按密度一致性排序
reason: 预印本新方法含 52 例基准，但未经同行评审、证据有限
abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] Identifying the molecular components of cryoEM/cryoET maps of endogenous or poorly characterized complexes remains a major bottleneck. CryoID2 addresses this by integrating deep learning-based feature prediction with sequence prioritization and structural evaluation. Three 3D U-Nets extract structure classes, key-atom positions, and reduced residue/nucleotide types from the input map. These predictions support backbone tracing and the generation of short sequence queries that rank candidates from a user-supplied pool-using BLASTp for proteins and a maximin strategy for RNA. Corresponding PDB or AlphaFold models are then retrieved, rigidly fitted using predicted features and experimental density, and ranked by map agreement. Module-level tests show high-recall feature prediction and resolution-dependent atom clustering, while a 52-case benchmark recovers near-reference fitting quality. In practice, cryoID2 correctly identified PfA-M17 from a 166-protein mass-spectrometry pool and the unannotated Ca-raiA RNA from a genome-derived non-coding sequence set, demonstrating a unified sequence-plus-structure route to molecular identification in cryoEM maps.
zh_abstract: [bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology] 鉴定内源性或表征不佳复合物的冷冻电镜（cryoEM）/冷冻电子断层扫描（cryoET）图谱中的分子组分仍是一个主要瓶颈。CryoID2 通过将基于深度学习的特征预测与序列优先级排序和结构评估相结合来解决这一问题。三个 3D U-Net 从输入图谱中提取结构类别、关键原子位置以及简化的残基/核苷酸类型。这些预测支持主链追踪，并生成短序列查询；这些查询使用针对蛋白质的 BLASTp 和针对 RNA 的 maximin 策略，从用户提供的候选池中对候选进行排序。随后检索相应的 PDB 或 AlphaFold 模型，利用预测特征和实验密度进行刚性拟合，并按与图谱的一致性排序。模块级测试显示高召回率特征预测和分辨率依赖的原子聚类，而一个 52 例基准测试恢复了接近参考的拟合质量。在实践中，cryoID2 从 166 种蛋白质的质谱池中正确鉴定出 PfA-M17，并从基因组来源的非编码序列集中鉴定出未注释的 Ca-raiA RNA，展示了在 cryoEM 图谱中通过序列加结构的统一途径进行分子鉴定。
